ltc3300_1.omitted_losses: switching transition, gate drive and core losses
ltc3300_1.topology_note: transformer-based bidirectional flyback; range check only

buck_boost.calibration_points: mean over all three operating points per (L, f)

soc_estimation.reference_definition: 1 at the start of each drive file (preceded by a full charge to 4.2 V with 50 mA cut-off) minus integrated tester current over the C/20 discharge capacity at that temperature
soc_estimation.label_note: tester current accuracy is 0.1 % of a 75 A full scale (dataset readme), so the integrated label can drift by up to 75 mA times the cycle time

ekf2.states: SOC, two RC voltages, one-state hysteresis

scaling.ml_model_note: the 4-cell surrogate takes 4 SOCs, 4 capacities and 4 resistances as inputs and cannot represent N != 4

midsem_consistency.midsem_cell_model: assumed generic 3 Ah NMC cell, midsem flying-capacitor formula

flying_capacitor.coth_formula: R_eq = (1/(f C)) coth(1/(4 f R C)), R = r0 + 2 Rds_on + ESR per phase

voltage_balancing.sensor_model: fixed offset N(0, sigma) per cell plus white noise sigma / sqrt(60) per second (60 s average); rest voltage mapped to SOC with the fitted OCV curve

technique_selector.components: mid-range component values for every technique
technique_selector.surrogate: gradient boosting models of section h, trained on the 80 % training split
